methodSections.heading: Dressing
steps: Finely dice the onion, celery and carrot.
Sauté the onion in a splash of oil until caramelized.
Add the celery and carrots and stir until they begin to release steam.
Add the sugar, salt, water and pomegranate molasses. Bring to a boil and then simmer on a low heat for 10 minutes or until everything has softened.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool.
Add the red wine vinegar and olive oil to the cooked vegetables and then blend in a blender until smooth.
Pass through a strainer collecting the dressing in a bowl.

methodSections.heading: Halloumi and Tomato
steps: Slice the halloumi into ½cm (¼in) thick pieces.
Slice the tomato to same thickness as the halloumi.
Roughly chop the nuts and finely shred the mint as a garnish.
Heat a frying pan with a splash of oil to medium high heat.
Pan fry the halloumi for roughly 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and some colour is starting on the sides.
Layer the cooked halloumi on a serving plate with the fresh tomato slices. Drizzle the dressing over each of the layers.
Sprinkle the chopped nuts over the top layer and finish with chopped mint.
